newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SMIT SHARES TO BE SOLD AT 48 GUILDERS.
newsitem.headline: SMIT SHARES TO BE SOLD AT 48 GUILDERS.

text.p: Smit Internationale NV said on Tuesday that its majority shareholders Nedlloyd and Vigilanter were offering Smit shares at 48 guilders per share.
The transaction was announced on June 5.
Transport group Nedlloyd and unlisted investment firm Vigilanter now each hold a 40 percent interest in shipping company Smit Internationale.
A total of 5.12 million shares are publicly offered. The banking syndicate which is backing the transaction has an option to buy an additional 768,724 shares to cover over-allotments.
If all shares offered are taken up, Nedlloyd will have completely sold its stake and Vigilanter will retain a five percent interest.
As previously announced, Smit will buy 789,910 of the shares at the set price of 48 guilders each.
